title: Student Model Transparency to Overseer: Does Giving Overseers Access to Model Internals Improve Oversight?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Comparing three conditions (outputs only, outputs + confidence, outputs + internals) is structured. The simplified version (condition 2: confidence scores) is accessible; condition 3 is harder.
